title: Browser sessions and CSRF

richText: With form login, Spring Security saves successful authentication in the HTTP session.
The browser sends the session cookie on later requests.
Spring loads the saved security context before checking those requests.
Spring changes the session ID during login to protect against session fixation.
Logout invalidates the session and clears its authentication.
